findings.repair: Add a short powered roller floor, belt or bounded pusher mechanism to the tray, preserving side collar and pressure-hardware clearance.

findings.repair: Fill the actual bounded downstream positions and hold the next cooked fish upstream; alternatively show a normal open/green handoff, but required blocked-state proof must remain elsewhere.

findings.repair: Provide terminal end-stop or clearly depicted downstream reserved stop so goods cannot simply run off the finite tray.
